name: EPIC 206069764
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 7.4 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,846 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.90 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,661 K at its surface.
